Application Data.NAME: Smith & Sons Post Office
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Smith & Sons Post Office operates as a full-service postal facility, offering mailing and shipping services for individuals and businesses. We provide a range of services including package delivery, certified mail, postal banking, and retail sales of postage stamps and shipping supplies. Additionally, we offer private mailbox rentals and notary services to meet the diverse needs of our customers in the Springfield area. Our knowledgeable staff is committed to delivering excellent customer service and ensuring all postal needs are met efficiently.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 02/15/2023, a customer accidentally slipped and fell in the lobby area due to a wet floor, resulting in a minor injury. The claim was filed for medical expenses totaling $1,000.00. The status of the claim was closed after settlement.
